options.name: Dash
options.summary: You gain extra movement equal to your Speed this turn; a second Dash in the same turn adds it again.

options.name: Disengage
options.summary: Your movement this turn provokes no opportunity attacks.

options.name: Dodge
options.summary: Until the start of your next turn, attacks against you have Disadvantage and you have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws; you lose this while you are Incapacitated or your Speed is 0.

options.name: Fighter Action Surge
options.summary: Take one more action this turn. Once per Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Fighter Second Wind
options.summary: Catch your breath and regain 1d10 + your Fighter level in Hit Points. You have a few uses; a Short Rest gives one back.

options.name: Help Assist Attack Roll
options.summary: Pick a foe within 5 feet of you: the next attack roll an ally makes against it before your next turn has Advantage.

options.name: Longsword attack
options.summary: Attack a creature within the weapon's reach. A hit deals the weapon's damage.

options.name: Unarmed Attack
options.summary: Punch, kick or headbutt a creature within your reach. A hit deals bludgeoning damage of 1 plus your Strength modifier.

options.name: Potion of Healing
options.summary: Drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 feet. The drinker regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.
